content.overview: Section 230 is the Tribunal scheme jurisdiction for compromises with creditors or members.
content.glance: Section 230 is the Tribunal scheme jurisdiction for compromises with creditors or members.
content.study: Notice, disclosure, majority in number and three-fourths in value, and sanction are mandatory. Takeover offers have extra conditions. The order is filed and then binds dissenting members of the class.
